subtasks.title: Create WSS test harness with mocked processManager
subtasks.description: Set up an HTTP server + WSS replica of server.ts, with vi.mock processManager. Connect real ws clients for testing.

notes: All 11 acceptance criteria are implemented in a single test file due to high setup cost (each test creates a real HTTP+WSS server). The core streaming paths (event, error, terminal-data), client→server terminal I/O, connection lifecycle, and error handling are tested in subsections within the file.
